name: KT Plastics, Inc
old_description: KT Plastics specializes in custom sealing solutions with the capability to mold plastics into a wide range of shapes, sizes, and angles. Some of the diameters can be extreme and the tolerances very high, but KT Plastics has the staff, equipment, and materials to make the seemingly impossible possible.
about:
KT Plastics, Inc. was established in January 1989 in Calera, Oklahoma, as a compression molding business with a full-service machine shop. The company began by molding PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene, known as Teflon®) rod and tubing billets, as well as PTFE blended with fillers such as bronze, glass, carbon, graphite, nickel, and molybdenum to alter chemical and physical properties.

Today the firm operates a 38,000‑square‑foot manufacturing facility housing six large compression molding presses, eight CNC lathes, two CNC mills, seven manual turning lathes, three multi‑station thermoform ovens, three high‑temperature curing ovens, two high‑temperature extruders, two high‑temperature injection molding presses, large‑capacity blenders, recycling grinders, and downstream extrusion equipment. Its capabilities span compression molding (including free sintering), injection molding, thermoforming, extrusion, high‑temperature compression molding (HTCM), CNC machining, polymer blending and fabrication, mold fabrication, and coating and surface treatment.

KT Plastics serves a broad range of industries including oil and gas, chemical, transportation, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, heavy equipment and mining, water treatment, food and beverage, medical and pharmaceutical, waste and recycling, agriculture, and paper and pulp milling. A notable early thermoforming project produced lids for metal dumpsters, and Raytheon later engaged the company to develop parts trays for missile production.

The company emphasizes its ability to achieve extreme diameters and tight tolerances that make “the seemingly impossible possible.” Partnerships with Lone Star Molding (2014) and Symmtek Polymers (2016) expanded its material portfolio to include high‑performance thermoplastics such as PEEK and enabled on‑site resin blending for HTCM. KT Plastics maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification to ensure consistent quality.
